name: Token concentration

subjectOf.text: Token concentration in existing decentralized protocols is extreme: on and around September 12, 2017, 4.11 percent of bitcoin addresses controlled 96.53 percent of the total bitcoin supply.
subjectOf.abstract: For instance, on and around September 12, 2017, 4.11% of the bitcoin addresses controlled 96.53% of the total bitcoin supply.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain-Based Corporate Governance (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3441904

subjectOf.text: If the top 10 addresses own a disproportionally large supply of a token, the project or community becomes more centralized, an outcome fair launches seek to avoid.
subjectOf.abstract: If the top 10 addresses own a disproportionally large supply of a token, then the project or community becomes more centralized; an outcome which fair launches seek to avoid.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Fair Token Launch (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4015908
scope_conditions: token supply concentration measured across top holder addresses
